specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game asset for Chinese 2D factory-building game 喂——出来. Overhead camera on a square orthogonal grid; minimal south-facing vertical surfaces, no isometric diamond footprint, no realistic rendering, no gradients or noisy microdetails. No labels, text, numbers, borders, grid lines, watermark, logos, or UI baked into art. Create ONE square opaque ground texture tile filling the entire canvas edge to edge: plain compacted grey-brown soil mixed with a little worn concrete dust, suitable for a poor underground industrial settlement. Quiet sparse broad pixel mottling with very low contrast so characters/items remain easy to see. No objects, stones, structures, paths, shadows, grass, grid, or highlights at the edges. Edges should visually connect when repeated. Strict top-down flat surface. This is a ground TILE, not an illustration or scene.
